'''Crizlon''' was a [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]] [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] who [[Slicer/Legends|sliced]] into several military databases during the then-ongoing [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Mission" /> By [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Reclaim What's Ours" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> he had begun [[Thief/Legends|stealing]] information from both of those governments.<ref name="Mission" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
By that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> an individual associated with one of the two sides in the Republic&ndash;Empire struggle sent a companion to<ref name="Mission" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Vinsoth">{{TORcite|type=codex|Chevin}}</ref> [[Vinsoth/Legends|Vinsoth]] to recover classified data before Crizlon could sell it to the faction on the opposing side. Slicing into Crizlon's [[Computer/Legends|computers]], the companion discovered his theft of information from both the Empire and Republic. The companion recovered the data and then wiped the [[Datacore/Legends|datacores]] of all information.<ref name="Mission" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Crizlon was mentioned in [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', within the Crew Skill mission "Reclaim What's Ours," though the information about the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="Mission" />
